capabilities: Edit Mermaid flowcharts visually on a canvas
Sync valid changes back into the original Markdown code block

extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.13.1 or later. The visual canvas becomes read-only for unsupported or ambiguous flowchart syntax to avoid lossy changes. Stores only global UI preferences; makes no network requests.
intentEvidence: local, offline Obsidian plugin for editing standard mermaid code blocks as source or on a flowchart canvas
problem: Obsidian renders Mermaid code blocks but offers no visual way to edit them, and external diagram tools break Markdown portability.
